A '''diamond axe''' is the [[Diamond equipment|diamond]] [[Tools#Axe|axe]], crafted from [[Diamond|diamonds]]. It mines at speed 9 and has 2500 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/diamond_axe.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

The vanilla recipe is blocked and replaced by the pack's own, which sets the stats shown in the infobox.

=== Chest loot ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===

It mines axe blocks at speed 9 (vanilla: 8).

The pack adds beds, candles, cactus and honeycomb blocks to the blocks axes mine quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/axe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===

It deals 9 damage with an attack speed of 1.

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[Diamond|diamonds]]. The pack keeps the repair cost at zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely (see [[Repairing]]).

=== Smelting ingredient ===
In a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]], it smelts into one [[Diamond|diamond]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/diamond_from_blasting_diamond_materials.json}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|1.12.2|Diamond ores now drop [[Raw Diamond|raw diamonds]], which must be smelted in a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]].}}
